senses.gloss: m. (b. h.) head, point; beginning, heading; main thing, principal.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Chullin 4:1">Ḥull. IV, 1</cite> <he>הוציא את רֹאשׁוֹ וכ׳</he> if the embryo put forth its head, although it withdrew it again.
<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 71:2">Gen. R. s. 71</cite>, beg., v. <cite ref="O00388"><he>סוֹף</he></cite>.

<cite ref="Midrash Mishlei 1:7">Midr. Prov. to I, 7</cite> <he>ר׳ הפרק ר׳ המסכתא ר׳ הפרשה</he> the heading of a chapter, of a treatise, of a section.—<he>ר׳ החדש</he>, <he>ר׳ השנה</he> &c., v. respective determinants.—

<cite ref="Megillah 12b:11">Meg. 12ᵇ</cite> <he>קופץ בר׳</he>, v. <cite ref="E00117"><he>הֶדְיוֹט</he></cite>.—<he>בת ר׳</he>, v. <cite ref="B01378"><he>בַּת</he> II</cite>.—Sifra B’ḥuck., Par. 2, ch. VIII (ref. to <he>יען וביען</he>, <cite ref="Leviticus 26:43">Lev. XXVI, 43</cite>) <he>וכי ר׳ בר׳ פרעתי מהם וכ׳</he> did I collect from them full amount for full amount? did I not collect only one hundredth of their sins before me? <cite ref="Sanhedrin 3a">Snh. 3ᵃ</cite> sq. <he>ממון שאינו משתלם בר׳ הוא</he> an indemnity not for the exact amount (more or less).

B. Kam. 65ᵇ (ref. to Lev. V, 24) ממון … בר׳ מוסיף חומש וכ׳ where the indemnity is for the full amount (and no more), the fine of a fifth is added, but where it is not for the exact amount (but more) &c.; a. v. fr.—מֵר׳ from the beginning, over again.
<cite ref="Avodah Zarah 3a:10">Ab. Zar. 3ᵃ</cite> <he>תנה לנו מר׳ וכ׳</he> give us it (the Law) over again, and we will observe it.—Pl. <he>רָאשִׁים</he>, <he>רָאשִׁין</he>.
<cite ref="Mishnah Chullin 2:2">Ḥull. II, 2</cite> <he>השוחט שני ר׳ כאחד</he> if one cuts two heads at one time.
<cite ref="Chagigah 13a:10">Ḥag. 13ᵃ</cite> <he>רָאשֵׁי פרקים</he>, v. <cite ref="Q01982"><he>פֶּרֶק</he></cite>; a. fr.—Trnsf.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Rosh Hashanah 1:5:4">Y. R. Hash. I, 57ᵇ</cite> bot. <he>ר׳ גדר היה וכ׳</he> it was the chief magistrate of Gadara &c., v. <cite ref="T00036"><he>רֵאשִׁית</he></cite>; Bab.
<cite ref="Rosh Hashanah 22a:1">R. Hash. 22ᵃ</cite> <he>שזפר ראשָׁהּ וכ׳</he> Sh. the chief &c.
<cite ref="Shabbat 33b:5">Sabb. 33ᵇ</cite>; <cite ref="Berakhot 63b:6">Ber. 63ᵇ</cite>, v. <cite ref="M00240"><he>מְדַבֵּר</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Berakhot 57b:8">Ib. 57ᵇ</cite>, v. <cite ref="J00689"><he>יְשִׁיבָה</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Horayot 3:5:2">Y. Hor. III, 48ᵇ</cite> bot. <he>ר׳ משמר</he> the chief of the Temple guard; <he>ר׳ בית אב</he> the chief of a priestly family.

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Horayot 3:5:2">Ib.</cite> [read:] <he>ר׳ וזקן ר׳ קודם שאינו ר׳ וכ׳</he> as between the chief (the Nasi, of the academy) and an elder (scholar), the chief has the precedence, for none can be chief unless he has been an elder; a. v. fr.—Pl. as ab.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Horayot 3:5:2">Ib.</cite> <he>משה הקדים ר׳ לזקנים</he> Moses placed the chiefs before the elders (<cite ref="Deuteronomy 29:9">Deut. XXIX, 9</cite>).

<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 61">Gen. R. s. 61</cite> <he>כולהון ראשי אומות הן</he> they are all (names derived from) tribal chiefs (v. <cite ref="L00310"><he>לוּפָר</he></cite>, a. correct citation acc.); a. fr.—

units: Neg. XIII, 2, v. פָּתִין.—Pl. as ab.
Ib. נראה בר׳ Bab. ed. (Mish. ed. sing.) if the leprous spot appeared on the crossbeams.—

units: <cite ref="Mishnah Kelim 18:2">Kel. XVIII, 2</cite> <he>כיצד … ר׳ ת׳</he> how is a piece of furniture with an arched top-piece measured? By drawing an equilateral triangle circumscribing the curve.
<cite ref="Mishnah Kilayim 2:7">Kil. II, 7</cite> <he>היה ר׳ ת׳ חטים וכ׳</he> if a triangular point of a wheat field is wedged in a barley field.
<cite ref="Mishnah Kilayim 3:3">Ib. III, 3</cite>.

B. Bath. 62ᵃ (if the seller defined the limits of his field by describing one long side and one short side) ויקנה כנגד ר׳ ת׳ why not let the buyer have possession of an ‘ox-head’, i.e. draw a trapezoid with the two unequal sides?—Pl. רָאשֵׁי תוֹרִין.
